stair-treads/longboat-key.title: Stair Treads Longboat Key FL | Villa & Townhome Install
stair-treads/longboat-key.description: Stair treads on Longboat Key mostly go in two-story villas and townhomes in Country Club Shores and Bay Isles, matched to the floor above, 2026 pricing.
stair-treads/longboat-key.h1: Stair Treads in Longboat Key Villas and Townhomes
stair-treads/longboat-key.lede: Most Longboat Key living happens on a single floor with elevator access, so stair tread work here is concentrated in a smaller slice of the island's housing stock: two-story villas and townhome-style units.
stair-treads/longboat-key.capsule: Stair treads are a smaller share of our Longboat Key business than on the mainland, since most of the island's condo towers put every unit on one floor with elevator access. Where stairs do exist, mainly two-story villas in Country Club Shores and Bay Isles, engineered hardwood treads run $110 to $180 per tread installed in 2026, with risers $25 to $65, usually matched to whatever flooring goes in above.
stair-treads/longboat-key.body_html:
Interior stairs are the exception on Longboat Key rather than the rule. The island's dominant housing type is a mid-rise or low-rise condo tower where every unit sits on one floor and residents use an elevator, so most of our stair treads work here comes from the smaller share of the market built as a two-story villa or townhome-style unit, concentrated in neighborhoods like Country Club Shores, Bay Isles and some of the older sections near the Longboat Key Club. If a condo project we're quoting is entirely single-level units, we tell the owner honestly that stair tread work simply doesn't apply to their building.

Where stairs do exist, the tread material is almost always chosen to match whatever flooring is going in on the level above, which on Longboat Key usually means wide-plank engineered hardwood or a premium tile. A two-story Country Club Shores villa refloored in European oak upstairs would typically carry that same species down the staircase in engineered tread form rather than switching to a painted or carpeted step, since a mismatched staircase stands out in a renovation this far up the price range. Because Longboat Key sits almost entirely in an AE or VE flood zone, we also flag when a staircase lands in a ground-level entry that's seen water before, in which case a waterproof LVP tread often makes more sense than hardwood despite the mismatch, an approach detailed on our waterproof flooring page.

A fourteen-tread staircase in a villa like the ones scattered through Bay Isles is a realistic illustration: risers and treads both need to clear the association's slip-resistance expectations, and on an island where sandy, wet feet come straight off the beach or the pool deck, we lean toward a textured tread nosing rather than a smooth finish regardless of material. For the townhome-style units that do have stairs, our post on whether you can put vinyl plank flooring on stairs covers the waterproof option in more depth, and the Longboat Key area page has the fuller picture of which neighborhoods run villa-style versus tower-style.
stair-treads/longboat-key.cost_html: A fourteen-tread staircase in a Bay Isles or Country Club Shores villa, fitted with engineered hardwood treads at $110-$180 each, runs $1,540-$2,520 for the treads alone in 2026. Add risers at $25-$65 each ($350-$910), and the full staircase runs $1,890-$3,430 installed. Swapping to solid hardwood treads at $130-$220 each pushes the tread cost to $1,820-$3,080 before risers. For a townhome unit near a flood-exposed entry where waterproof material matters more than species match, LVP treads at $65-$105 each bring the same fourteen-step staircase down to $910-$1,470. Material-by-material pricing for every tread option is on our stair treads cost guide.

faqs.q: Do Longboat Key condos have interior stairs?
faqs.a: Rarely. Most Longboat Key condo towers put every unit on a single floor with elevator access, so stair tread work here is mostly limited to the island's two-story villas and townhome-style units in places like Country Club Shores and Bay Isles.

faqs.q: Should stair treads match the flooring in my Longboat Key villa?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. Most Longboat Key stair jobs match the tread species or material to whatever is going in on the floor above, so a wide-plank European oak install upstairs typically carries the same engineered hardwood down the staircase.

faqs.q: Are hardwood stair treads a bad idea near a flood-exposed entry on Longboat Key?
faqs.a: They can be. If a staircase starts at a ground-level entry that's taken on water before, we often recommend a waterproof LVP tread instead of hardwood, even if it means the tread material doesn't match the floor above.
